name: Mobile coils + US
full_name: Three-electromagnet parallel mechanism with US probe for guidewire steering
group: Zhang, CUHK Mechanical and Automation Engineering
target_anatomy: abdominal/peripheral phantom (bifurcated 5 mm ID silicone channel)
devices_driven: own replica-moulded guidewire: 50 um nitinol wire, PDMS cannula 1 mm OD, NdFeB magnet 1.2 mm OD x 2 mm at tip
n_dof_detail: parallel mechanism of three electromagnets and US probe; 1-axis motorised feeder (1-15 mm/s, devices 0.5-5 mm)
imaging_compat: B-mode US at 22 Hz for tracking (radiation-free)
validation_detail: three paths x three trials, tip reached target in all trials
key_numbers: 30 mT per electromagnet at 100 mm, 12 mT omnidirectional at 100 mm; mean tip error 1.79 mm; speed 3.08 mm/s; kinematic modelling error 0.89 mm; field kept at 5 mT during run
sim_model: constant-curvature kinematic model with corrective angle (full)
